CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate list) is explicitly reported, an accessibility/presentation label ('current') and an origin/status field are present and separately quoted.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to a named content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content listings identify coordinates for named referents and attributes (red/blue).

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, etc.) explicitly attribute different organization/presentation/status to identified contents.

O.rationale: The report states presentation/organization properties (grid orientation) and labels origins/presentation kinds that describe how content is represented or accessible (native_conditional_record, copied_prior_record).
